title: A block sequence is replaced by a scalar
notes: The new value is written on the key's line (`a: x`), which is what the case expects; a block mapping or sequence replaced by a scalar may also be written with the value on the next line, indented (`a:\n  x`, production 194 in the block-out context), which reads back the same. The specification does not choose between the two, so the bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md) and the case carries the tag `convention`.
